aliases: Powered Wi-Fi Floodlight Deterrence HD+ Camera with 2-Way Audio
features: microSD or Night Owl recorder storage

frigate.notes: Night Owl cameras stream through the Night Owl DVR/NVR — point Frigate at the recorder's IP, one channel per camera: /ch01/0 (main) and /ch01/1 (sub), where 01 is the channel number. No direct-to-camera ONVIF/RTSP. RTSP path from the community RTSP-patterns layer (issue #268).

release_notes: Night Owl CAM-FWIP3-FL: a hardwired Wi-Fi floodlight camera (2500-lumen motion floodlights) with 3MP HD+ resolution, 100 ft night vision, a 120 wide view and two-way audio. Consumer product-page specs — Night Owl does not publish sensor/lens details; unlisted fields omitted, form-factor from the product listing.
